upstream.transform: columns itemid, era, level, stage0 only (the name and review columns dropped: ids and tags only, names come from the player's DATs); level = max(equip_level, N of a source of scroll_level:N), so the 91 scroll hidden_level rows keep their gate; rows and order otherwise unchanged

meta.names: Humanized public item_basic.sql identifiers; no game DATs or icons copied.
meta.eligibility: baseEligible checks result BASE era + result level <=60 + every craft requirement <=70. Character skills, key items, inventory, status and active server era must still be validated by the server. Null indicates unknown metadata.
